capabilities: Render lollipop gene variant diagrams from gene-code code blocks
Render pedigree diagrams from gene-code code blocks
Display diagrams as inline SVG figures in notes
extras: Listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is short and points rendering details to the separate @gene-code/core package.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to render lifescience-specific diagrams like gene variant lollipops or family pedigrees from text.

relations.evidence: Rendering is provided by @gene-code/core; this plugin is the thin Obsidian integration layer

summary: Code-block renderer that draws lifescience diagrams—lollipop gene variant plots and pedigree charts—as inline SVG figures in notes.
